aggregationRule: generally X if no mapped question is state 3 and at most k=21 are state 2; insufficient if any state 4; else not X (GAO-11-82R; GAO-23-106549 pp. 7-8)

objectivity.qualifier: generally objective, with concerns: DES-2 (the question is stated but not every term is defined); EXE-1 (a plan exists but does not demonstrably cover the primary objectives); PRE-3 (claims are presented but no evaluation run exists in the record); PRE-4 (claims are presented but no evaluation run exists in the record)

reliability.qualifier: generally reliable, with concerns: DES-6 (sensitivity covered some assumptions); EXE-5 (only some cited evidence describes its reliability steps); PRE-2 (claims are presented but no evaluation run exists in the record); PRE-3 (claims are presented but no evaluation run exists in the record)
